plan.archetype: Efficient early attacks into poison and dexterity scaling
plan.bossPrep: Establish reliable damage and dexterity, preserve a defensive potion, and prepare substantial block for the explosion after killing the body.
plan.summary: Add efficient damage first, then poison scaling and stronger defense. Use potions to limit early losses; take manageable elites. Remove Strikes once damage improves, and balance upgrades against boss-entry health.

plan.archetype: Efficient early attacks into poison and scaling defense
plan.bossPrep: Bring reliable damage, upgraded poison or attacks, stronger block, and potions. Strip Slippery with cheap hits; reserve mitigation for Dismember.
plan.summary: Secure early damage and area coverage before adding poison scaling. Improve defense without bloating the deck. Upgrade key cards when healthy; use Boots to reach valuable rooms and escape dangerous routes.
